title: ROOFTOP FLOW
blurb: Nine rooftops in six sections, with raised ducts to slide under and a red finish gate.

verification.notes: Resumed once after the Go usage limit cut it off. Spawns grounded facing the route; sprint carries the player forward to the first raised duct, which needs a slide (same layout idea as minimax-high). Its own headless smoke test finishes the level in 58 s.
